title: Design Model Maker Co-op – Summer 2027
note: Model shop co-op building prototype models for Crown's ID team; Industrial Design majors preferred; no visa sponsorship.

facts.summary: Summer co-op in the Crown Design Model Shop making scale and full-size prototypes for the industrial design staff.
facts.duties: Assist model makers with CAD/CAM, CNC milling, 3D printing, molding, woodworking and fabrication; time for a personal project.
facts.requirements: Enrolled in a 2- or 4-year degree, preferably Industrial Design; own reliable transportation. Crown does not sponsor; temporary-visa holders are not eligible.
